title: 第17章 斩杀秦向天第18章 百倍偿还
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
“雷神灭世！”
万千雷霆在秦向天的身上游动，每一道雷霆似乎都有毁天灭地的力量！
秦向天往前狠狠的一掌打出，雷霆咆哮而来击中林白的胸口，当场就将林白打得口吐鲜血。
“哈哈哈，黄口小儿，我看你现在怎么狂！”秦向天击中林白，顿时士气大振，乘胜追击，一道道的雷霆宛如神雷一般的从他身上呼啸出来。
林白面色难看，在雷霆落下之地，东躲西藏！
“死吧！死吧！”
秦向天满脸狰狞的怒笑道。
“谁生谁死，还有未可知呢！”林白脚步再次躲开了一道雷霆之后，突然身子飞冲上前，血色之光在身上凝聚，让林白宛如是一支血色之剑一般势不可挡！
“冷血一剑！”
咻——
一剑洞穿，将秦向天身上的雷霆之力全部震碎，剑锋突变，林白将秦向天的左臂斩落下来！
“啊！”失去左臂，秦向天痛苦的惨叫起来。
嗡！
“混账东西，我要杀了你！”
秦向天愤怒的大叫起来，正当他要从地上爬起来和林白杀一个你死我活的时候，一命带着嗡鸣的剑，一瞬间抵在了秦向天的咽喉之处。
“什么！”秦向天难以置信，这世界上居然有这么快的剑吗？
顺着银白色的剑尖看上去，越过冰冷的剑身，秦向天看见了一双更加冰冷的眼神！
“我在给你最后一次机会，铁海棠，铁峰在那？”林白冷漠的问道。
“别杀我，被杀我。”秦向天害怕了。
“住手！”

正当这个时候，旁边的李书生去洞府中将已经重伤累累的铁峰拉了出来，用一柄剑架在铁峰的脖子上，对林白喊道：“你敢伤我盟主，我就杀了铁峰！”
“铁峰盟主，你没事吧。”林白担忧的问道。
铁峰急忙说道：“我没事，只是受了一些轻伤，林白，你快去救海棠，他被秦向天的妻子抓到雷泽去了。”
“什么？”林白一惊。
雷泽是什么地方？
雷泽是青灵山脉之中最危险的地方，常年天雷密布，进去的武者，十死无生！
李书生说道：“快放了我们盟主，否则的话，我杀了铁峰。”
秦向天也说道：“对对对，快放了我，否则的话，李书生是必定要杀了铁峰的，放了我，我保证你和铁峰平安无事！”
“哼哼。”林白一剑破开秦向天的咽喉。
一位在青灵山脉叱咤风云多年的擎天盟盟主，就此死在了林白的手中。
李书生惊骇无比的看着林白：“你当真以为我不敢杀了铁峰吗？”
“你敢吗？”林白瞪着李书生问道。
“我……”李书生愤怒无比，但却不敢下剑杀了铁峰。
“你看看这斩妖盟峡谷之中，你擎天盟的武者我杀了多少？现在你们的盟主都死在了我的手中，你觉得你能逃得掉？”林白一声冷笑。
“现在的你，命可是掌握在我的手中。”
“放了铁峰，我放你走！”
林白对李书生说道。
李书生道：“我凭什么相信你？”
林白笑道：“现在你除了相信我，你还有其他的路吗？”
“这个选择就很简单了，你杀了铁峰，然后我杀了你，我已经杀了这么多人了，不在乎多你一个。”

“那么第二个选择，你放了铁峰，我放你走，就算我会反悔，但你也有五成的机率离开呀。”
“第一个选择，可是必死无疑的死路！”
林白笑了笑的说道。
李书生眼睛滴溜溜的一转，看向林白：“好小子，你果然是一个人物，秦向天死在你手上不冤枉！我们青山不改，绿水长流！”
content_en:
"Thunder God destroys the world!"
Thousands of thunderbolts were swimming around Qin Xiangtian's body, and every thunderbolt seemed to have the power to destroy the heaven and the earth!
Qin Xiangtian struck forward with a fierce palm, and the thunder roared and hit Lin Bai's chest, beating Lin Bai on the spot until he vomited blood.
"Hahaha, Huangkou kid, I see how crazy you are now!" Qin Xiangtian hit Lin Bai, and his morale was immediately boosted. He pursued the victory, and thunders roared out of him like divine thunder.
Lin Bai looked ugly, hiding in the place where the thunder fell!
"Die! Die!"
Qin Xiangtian said with a ferocious smile.
"It's still unclear who will live and who will die!" After Lin Bai dodged a thunderbolt again, he suddenly rushed forward. The bloody light condensed on his body, making Lin Bai as unstoppable as a bloody sword!
"A cold-blooded sword!"
Phew——
The sword pierced through, shattering all the thunder power on Qin Xiangtian's body. The sword's edge suddenly changed, and Lin Bai chopped off Qin Xiangtian's left arm!
"Ah!" Qin Xiangtian screamed in pain after losing his left arm.
Buzz!
"You bastard, I'm going to kill you!"
Qin Xiangtian yelled angrily. Just when he was about to get up from the ground and fight Lin Bai to the death, a sword with a buzzing sound was pressed against Qin Xiangtian's throat in an instant.
"What!" Qin Xiangtian couldn't believe it. Is there such a fast sword in this world?
Looking along the silver-white sword tip and across the cold sword body, Qin Xiangtian saw a pair of even colder eyes!
"I'm giving you one last chance, Tie Haitang, where is Tie Feng?" Lin Bai asked indifferently.
"Don't kill me, kill me." Qin Xiangtian was afraid.
"Stop!"
At this time, Li Shusheng next to him went to the cave to pull out the seriously injured Tiefeng, put a sword on Tiefeng's neck, and shouted to Lin Bai: "If you dare to hurt my leader, I will kill Tiefeng!"
"Leader of Iron Peak Alliance, are you okay?" Lin Bai asked worriedly.
Tiefeng said hurriedly: "I'm fine, I just suffered some minor injuries. Lin Bai, go and save Haitang quickly. He was captured by Qin Xiangtian's wife and taken to Lei Ze."
"What?" Lin Bai was shocked.
Where is Leize?
Leize is the most dangerous place in the Qingling Mountains. The sky is full of thunder all year round. Warriors who enter will die without any chance of survival!
Li Shusheng said: "Let our leader go quickly, otherwise, I will kill Tiefeng."
Qin Xiangtian also said: "Yes, yes, let me go quickly, otherwise, Shusheng Li will definitely kill Tiefeng. Let me go, and I will ensure that you and Tiefeng are safe!"
"Hmph." Lin Bai slit Qin Xiangtian's throat with a sword.
A leader of the Qingtian Alliance who had dominated the Qingling Mountains for many years died in Lin Bai's hands.
Li Shusheng looked at Lin Bai in horror: "Do you really think I don't dare to kill Tiefeng?"
"Do you dare?" Lin Bai stared at Li Shusheng and asked.
"I..." Li Shusheng was extremely angry, but he did not dare to kill Tiefeng with his sword.
"Look at this Demon Slaying Alliance canyon, how many warriors from your Qingtian Alliance have I killed? Now that your alliance leaders have died in my hands, do you think you can escape?" Lin Bai sneered.
"Now your life is in my hands."
"Let Tiefeng go, I'll let you go!"
Lin Bai said to Li Shusheng.
Li Shusheng said: "Why should I believe you?"
Lin Bai smiled and said, "Besides trusting me, do you have any other way now?"
"This choice is very simple. You kill Tiefeng, and then I will kill you. I have already killed so many people, and I don't care if there is one more of you."
"Then the second option is, you let Tiefeng go, and I let you go. Even if I regret it, you still have a 50% chance of leaving."
"The first choice is a sure way to death!"
Lin Bai said with a smile.
Li Shusheng's eyes flickered and he looked at Lin Bai:"Good boy, you are indeed a character. Qin Xiangtian's death in your hands is not unjust! Our green mountains will not change, and our green waters will always flow!"
